Along narrow periphery ONLY: tiny spools in ceramic cups, sewing basket, ribbons, linen, wooden drawers, pincushion, brass task lamp, jar of buttons, folded patchwork scraps, tiny plant. Top 25 percent shows cosy workshop shelves and a small sunlit window with gingham curtains, beautifully lit dust motes, many fine but orderly craft details. No people, animals, tools in central area, letters, UI, logos, watermarks. Lighting, detail, depth must be exquisite but central gameplay calm. Full bleed image.

assets.prompt: Create a production TRANSPARENT PNG pixel-art sprite atlas for the original cozy plush-repair game PATCH & PALS. Use attached workshop image as STYLE AND PALETTE REFERENCE ONLY, not background. Precisely 3 columns by 3 rows, nine isolated full-body sprites, equal square cells with at least 15% empty padding on EVERY side of each sprite. No overlap, no frames, no captions, no shadows detached from body, no background, real alpha. Camera near-front with slight overhead view, all toys seated facing viewer, full ears feet arms visible, same baseline and body scale in each row. Premium detailed pixel clusters / crisp stepped outlines / carefully grouped shading / felt weave in selective 2px clusters, handcrafted 1990s high fidelity pixel adventure look, not blurry, not smooth vector. Row1: adorable peach-coral long-eared rabbit plush with cream muzzle, button eyes and tiny sage ribbon. Row2: adorable butter-cream calico kitten plush, orange ear patch, pink nose, short paws, russet ribbon. Row3: adorable dusty turquoise baby dragon plush with cream belly, tiny gold horns, short round wings, soft limbs, pink ribbon. Each row columns: (1) tired droopy eyes, flatter/slumped body, mouth little frown; (2) repaired PLUMP alert and content, little smile, paws resting; (3) ecstatic eyes like upturned crescents, open happy smile, both arms raised in joyful celebration. Same identity proportions and design across columns. No holes, gore, lesions, scratches, clutter, tools or medical elements: game adds repair overlays separately. Strong dark plum contour and warm edge highlights harmonise with the oak/sage atelier. Keep ears/horns at least 10% from cell boundaries. Extremely appealing polished game characters, not rough placeholder.

EDIT the attached plush atlas to fix layout for safe game slicing. Keep the same NINE original plush designs, detailed crisp pixelart, palette, expressions, and 3-by-3 order. CRITICAL layout change: square 1536x1536 transparent canvas divided into exactly nine equal512x512 cells. Make EACH toy substantially SMALLER so its COMPLETE ears/feet/wings/tail are contained inside the CENTRAL 340x340 pixels of its cell, leaving at least86 pixels fully transparent on ALL FOUR sides. Fixed grid centers (256,256),(768,256),(1280,256),(256,768),(768,768),(1280,768),(256,1280),(768,1280),(1280,1280). Nine equally sized isolated figures. MUST leave wide blank gutters horizontally AND vertically; absolutely no figure can cross cell edge. Same rows: coral rabbit, cream calico, teal baby dragon. Same columns: sleepy slumped, awake plump smile, delighted arms-up. Same felt and tiny botanical-print details but group pixels for readable game sprites. No text, no background, no grid lines, no shadows. Actual transparent alpha; never fill blank areas. If necessary reduce ALL figures further to achieve reliable gutters.
